newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia money market rate eases 20 bps to 10.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Croatia money market rate eases 20 bps to 10.8 pct.

text.p: Croatia's weighted money market rate eased 20 basis points to 10.8 percent in brisker trade on Thursday.
Settlements totalled 32.8 million kuna, against an offer of 47 million.
Fresh loans accounted for 26.8 million, of which 26.5 were call money loans granted at a stable 10.5 percent.
Interbank rates ranged between 13 and 15 percent.
Insurers rolled over one-week funds at 9.0 percent.
The central bank's kuna midrates for Friday eased further to 5.8865 for the dollar and 3.5676 for the German mark. -- Sandra Kalogjera, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
